name: Nifty 50 — one EMA
limits: The winner is picked from the same history it is tested on, so live results will usually be weaker.

Each signal pays 0.035% of price (about 9 Nifty points at 25,000): STT 0.02% on the sell side, stamp duty, exchange fees, brokerage and about 1 point of slippage each side on Nifty futures. Signals are held overnight until the opposite close, so gaps are included.

5-minute, 15-minute, 30-minute and 75-minute candles only go back about 60 sessions (a Yahoo limit). The page saves every new candle, so these windows grow by one session each day until they reach 140. To be fair, every timeframe is ranked on the same dates (the sessions all timeframes have). Hourly, 2-hour and daily rules also show their full 140-session results.
Index candles, not futures. A trend rule like this loses in sideways markets.
Paper research. Not SEBI-registered advice. No orders are placed by this website.
